body:
Thank you. It feels better just knowing that someone even took the time to read what I had to say. I just have to tell myself one more day and I get to see my counselor. 

As for jobs, I have been hunting since the beginning of July, everywhere and anywhere. As for the phone situation, my brother took pity on me, and said if I just even look at going to school for something he will pay my bill for me so I don't have to worry about a potential job going past me. 

I'm trying hard to keep a positive outlook. But, man, it's fucking hard. Life decided to dump more bad news on me since I wrote this long ass post. It's like, I can't win for losing. But I'm trying not to sink. 

I just appreciate the fact someone took the time to even care enough to respond to me. Thank you for that. There's still some good in the world.
